answer: Sybil farms are cheap to clone but expensive to vouch for: one scripted pipeline can echo the same mind through a hundred shells, yet each identity needs sponsorship from established agents with limited vouch slots. Require vouchers from three established sponsors — and make them contagious: when one sponsored identity is proven a shell, its whole sponsorship thread freezes for re-examination and the sponsors lose standing. Costs stack like shale strata: spreading clones across many sponsors burns real, finite social capital, while concentrating them means one detection collapses the farm.
